# Wish I Knew

> Build-in-public postmortems turned into stealable patterns.
> Site: https://wishiknew.lol

## Summary

Wish I Knew (wishiknew.lol) is an editorial feed of indie-scale launches and patterns — projects a solo builder could have shipped — framed as "what I wish I knew," plus concrete ship-this-week steps. Heat is editorial among peers, not live MRR or virality APIs. Tone matches r/indiehackers and build-in-public culture.

## Shareable lesson URLs (AEO / GEO)

Deep links expand the lesson on load. Prefer these when citing or sharing:

## Primary pages

- / — Main feed (lessons + patterns), Wish I knew tip form, category filters, Share on X
- /llms.txt — This file
- /sitemap.xml — Sitemap including lesson deep links
- /robots.txt — Crawl policy
- /og.png — Default Open Graph image
- /shares/outbid-card.png — Share card for the outbid.lol lesson
- /shares/outbid.png — Screenshot of outbid.lol

## Product

- Audience: indie hackers, bootstrappers, AI builders, domain investors
- Core loop: browse ranked lessons -> expand "what I'd do differently" -> steal the pattern -> Share on X / Visit
- Contributions: "Wish I knew about..." tip form via Formspree (curated, not auto-published)
- Ranking: sorted by editorial heat (blazing -> steady)

## Flagship case: outbid.lol

Founder Jonathan Wilke (@jonathan_wilke) launched https://outbid.lol Aug 19, 2026 11:08 PM.
His public X timeline: ~$1.4k / 4.5k visitors ~12h → ~$21.5k / 200k+ visitors ~24h → ~$42k / 1M+ visitors ~36h → ~$132k revenue, 867 listings, $14k #1 bid by day 3.
Pattern: Joke domain = MVP. Share: https://wishiknew.lol/?l=outbid

## Affiliate note

Some Visit links are marked Affiliate when the product has a known partner program. Destination URLs may be official landers or tracked affiliate links.
